definition: to fill something too quickly and spill over
description: A cup under a coffee machine has filled past the brim and coffee is running out over the black worktop and pouring off the edge onto the kitchen floor. A young man in a purple hoodie rushes in and finds the kitchen sink filled to overflowing, the tap still running and white foam and water sheeting down the cupboard doors onto the tiles. He runs down the hallway to the bathroom, where the bathtub is full to the rim and a wall of foam is pouring over the side and spreading across the floor. He stands in the doorway with his hands in his hair, shouting, as the foam keeps rising out of the tub.
